notes.raw:
$^{*}$ α-NiS metastable below 623 K. Data extrapolated 1066-1250 K. Enthalpy of fusion and heat capacity of liquid estimated. Phase changes: 623 K, β - α transition point of NiS; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 1.400$ kcal/mol. 631 K, Curie temperature of Ni; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0$ kcal/mol. 1250 K, liquidus temperature of NiS, with melting beginning at 1066 K. Data extrapolated to give total enthalpy of fusion isothermally at 1250 K. Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations:
298.15-623 K: $Cp^o$ = 10.394 + 5.412x $10^{-3}T$ - 0.663x $10^5T^{-2}$
623-1250 K: $H^o$ - $H_{298}^o$ = 10.394x $10^{-3}T$ + 2.706x $10^{-6}T^2$ + 0.663x $10^2T^{-1}$ - 3.562 $Cp^o$ = 9.052 + 7.378x $10^{-3}T$ - 0.035x $10^5T^{-2}$
1250-1600 K: $H^o$ - $H_{298}^o$ = 9.052x $10^{-3}T$ + 3.689x $10^{-6}T^2$ + 0.035x $10^2T^{-1}$ - 1.607 $Cp^o$ = 17.000
$H^o$ - $H_{298}^o$ = 17.000x $10^{-3}T$ + 1.225
Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-623 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -38.569 + 3.227 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 1.734 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 91.150 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -38.569 - 3.227 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 1.734 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 45.575 \text{T}^{-1} + 42.822 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
623-631 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -36.613 + 1.885 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 0.751 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 28.350 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -36.613 - 1.885 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 0.751 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 14.175 \text{T}^{-1} + 31.741 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
631-750 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -34.064 - 6.439 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 6.274 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 30.650 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -34.064 + 6.439 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 6.274 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 15.325 \text{T}^{-1} - 21.459 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
750-1250 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -36.974 - 0.191 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 2.372 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 282.950 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -36.974 + 0.191 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 2.372 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 141.475 \text{T}^{-1} + 20.585 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1250-1600 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -34.143 + 7.758 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 1.317 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 279.450 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -34.143 - 7.758 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 1.317 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 139.725 \text{T}^{-1} + 70.386 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
Sources: All data to 1066 K from Mah (74) except enthalpy of transition at 623 K which is from Dubusc (33). Data extrapolated 1066-1250 K. Liquidus temperature from Kullerud (70). Heat capacity of liquid estimated.
